name: Pollen Robotics
summary: Pollen Robotics makes open-source robots, including the Reachy 2 humanoid and the Reachy Mini desktop robot. Hugging Face acquired the company in April 2025.
funding: Acquired by Hugging Face in April 2025 for an undisclosed amount.

sources.title: Hugging Face buys a humanoid robotics startup
Hugging Face to sell open-source robots thanks to Pollen Robotics acquisition
